description: This file provides a TypeScript implementation of a Twilio SMS provider, including functions for sending, scheduling, canceling SMS, verification, and webhook handling, with integration to Prisma for database checks and environment-based configurations.

methods.name: createTwilioClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a Twilio client instance using environment variables for credentials.

methods.name: getDefaultSender
methods.description: Returns the default sender phone number, optionally formatted for WhatsApp.

methods.name: getSMSNumber
methods.description: Formats the phone number for SMS or WhatsApp messaging.

methods.name: sendSMS
methods.description: Sends an SMS or WhatsApp message, with support for test mode and rate limiting.

methods.name: scheduleSMS
methods.description: Schedules an SMS or WhatsApp message for future delivery, with support for test mode.

methods.name: cancelSMS
methods.description: Cancels a scheduled SMS message by reference ID.

methods.name: sendVerificationCode
methods.description: Sends a verification code via SMS using Twilio Verify service.

methods.name: verifyNumber
methods.description: Verifies a phone number with a code using Twilio Verify service.

methods.name: getMessageBody
methods.description: Fetches the body of a message by its reference ID.

methods.name: isLockedForSMSSending
methods.description: Checks if SMS sending is locked for a user or team based on Prisma database state.

methods.name: getCountryCodeForNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the country code for a phone number via Twilio Lookup API.

methods.name: getMessageInfo
methods.description: Fetches message details such as price and segment count.

methods.name: validateWebhookRequest
methods.description: Validates a webhook request signature from Twilio.

methods.name: determineOptOutType
methods.description: Handles opt-out webhook requests from Twilio, validating signature and extracting opt-out info.

methods.name: deleteMultipleScheduledSMS
methods.description: Cancels multiple scheduled SMS messages concurrently.
